title: Elina Pilates Wall Unit With Mirror
overviewParagraph: The Wall Unit With Mirror is a versatile, wall-mounted workout station designed to maximize space while enabling countless exercises on a single machine. Its acrylic mirror finish helps you monitor form during home training so you can execute movements with proper technique. Built from high-quality wood and aluminum, the unit is adjustable to suit different exercises and user needs. The clean, elegant design keeps your training area functional without sacrificing style.
inclusions: One pair of soft foot loops
Push bar with five height positions
Side and center anchor points for spring attachment
Designed to be mounted flush against the wall
Dimensions: 55.5 cm (Mirror) X 180 cm X 7.5 cm. 80 cm (Maximum width)
